title: Practice 7: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Те ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general) плохо.
exercises.why: **ходили** — past tense (plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Как же вы ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general)?
exercises.why: **ходили** — past tense (plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Нет, нет, он не ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general).
exercises.why: **летал** — past tense (masculine) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Муха ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general), она видела!
exercises.why: **летала** — past tense (feminine) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Стрелы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) чрез Лыбедь.
exercises.why: **летали** — past tense (plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Орлы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) над его головою.
exercises.why: **летали** — past tense (plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Что ж ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general)?
Все не ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general)?
exercises.why: **ездили** — past tense (plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Вообразите, я всю ночь ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general).
exercises.why: **летал** — past tense (masculine) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) в свет?
___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general), летала, да к вам попала.
exercises.why: **летала** — past tense (feminine) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: И доктор ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general).

exercises.q: ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) ты вчера?

exercises.why: **ездила** — past tense (feminine) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Да, благодарить его ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general).
